c097.title: A Night at the Opera
c097.story: Grandma Halyna buys two tickets to the [[opera]] for Anna's birthday. Before the show, a string [[quartet]] plays a gentle [[sonata]] in the big hall. The story is about a sad [[phantom]] who lives under an old theater. A young [[soprano]] steps forward and sings a beautiful [[aria]] about love. Then a [[tenor]] answers her with a strong, warm voice. The [[maestro]] smiles and leads the whole [[ensemble]] into the final song. At the end, Anna claps so hard that her hands hurt. "Next year, I'm buying the tickets," she tells Grandma.

c098.title: Taras's Music Lesson
c098.story: Taras plays in the school band. Today his teacher sings two notes, [[fa]] and [[la]]. "The space between two notes is an [[interval]]," she says. Taras plays the [[trombone]], and his friend Ihor plays the [[tuba]]. A small girl plays the [[piccolo]] very high. Ihor's brother plays [[sax]] in the back. At the end, the teacher hits a big [[gong]]. Everyone laughs, and the lesson is over.

c099.title: Dance Lessons
c099.story: Anna and Max take dance lessons before cousin Olya's wedding. On Monday, they learn the [[tango]]. Max steps on Anna's foot twice. On Wednesday, they dance [[salsa]] and then [[samba]]. "We can dance this at the [[carnival]] in February!" says Anna. On Friday, the teacher shows them a fast [[polka]]. Max likes the [[boogie]] best. After class, they watch a [[ballet]] on TV. "A [[ballerina]] never steps on feet," Anna jokes. At the wedding, they dance the [[mambo]] all night, and nobody falls.

c100.title: Dad's Old Records
c100.story: On Sunday, Anna's dad opens an old box. Inside, there are old records on [[vinyl]] and some [[CDs|CD]]. He plays them on his big [[stereo]]. First, they listen to [[rock and roll]], then loud [[hard rock]]. "At school, I loved [[punk]] and [[new wave]]," Dad says. "I was a real [[rocker]] with long hair." He even played guitar in a [[rock band]]. Grandpa was a [[hippie]], and he played the [[banjo]]. "Now there is a [[revival]] of our music," Dad says happily. "It was a great [[era]]." Anna puts on Dad's [[retro]] jacket and asks, "Can I keep it?"

c101.title: Max's First Rave
c101.story: On Saturday night, Max goes to his first [[rave]] in an old factory. It is a [[mega]] party with hundreds of people and colorful lights. The DJ plays a long [[mix]] that starts with fast [[techno]]. Then the music turns into old [[acid house]], and everyone jumps. Next to Max, a quiet [[goth]] in black clothes plays a [[synth]] on a small stage. At sunrise, a band plays loud [[punk rock]], and Max dances until his legs hurt. In the morning, he texts Anna: "I need to sleep for two days!"

c102.title: Sofia Writes a Song
c102.story: Max's sister Sofia is a young [[songwriter]] who writes songs in her small room. She loves [[folk]], but she also listens to calm [[new age]] music. One day, a [[producer]] hears her songs and invites her to his studio. With her friend Oleh, she records a [[duet]] about the rain. He adds a long [[instrumental]] in the middle of the song. Later, a DJ makes a [[remix]], and it sounds great at parties. They plan the [[release]] of her [[debut]] album for May. The [[title track]] is a song about Kyiv at night. When the album comes out, the whole family listens to it together.

c103.title: The School Play
c103.story: Taras gets a big [[role]] in the school play. The show is at the city [[theater]] on Friday. The play is a [[drama]] about a lost kingdom. Taras plays a young [[prince]]. He is the [[protagonist]], so he has many lines. In the second act, he says a long [[monologue]]. In the next scene, a [[poet]] reads a [[sonnet]] at a [[masquerade]]. Before they start, every [[actor]] is nervous, but Taras is calm. Their teacher knows the whole school [[repertoire]] by heart. After the show, she says, "Taras, you have real [[talent]]!"

c104.title: A Weekend of Comedy
c104.story: On Friday, Anna and her friends start their comedy weekend with an [[improv]] show. After that, they see a short [[stand-up]] set by a nervous young comedian. On Saturday, they go to a [[cabaret]], where a [[drag queen]] welcomes everyone. The evening ends with a [[revue]] of songs from a famous [[musical]]. On Sunday, they buy cheap tickets for the [[matinee]] and laugh at a comedy [[duo]]. One joke about cats is a total [[fail]], but the two comedians laugh at it too. In the evening, they go to a charity [[gala]] at the city theater. There, an old [[artiste]] with great [[humor]] sings and tells funny stories. The last act is a short [[farce]] about two lost brothers. At midnight, Max says, "My face hurts from laughing!"

c105.title: A Day at the Museum
c105.story: On Saturday, Anna takes Max to the [[art]] museum. First, they visit the [[Renaissance|renaissance]] room. Max likes a [[portrait]] of a young man in a red hat. Anna likes a painting of the [[Madonna|madonna]] with a baby. The guide says it is full of [[symbolism]]. Next, Anna looks at the [[contour]] of a face in a drawing. Then they see statues by a famous [[sculptor]]. Each statue stands on a stone [[pedestal]]. Max wants to sit on a chair, but it is an [[antique]]! Upstairs, there are modern paintings in the style of [[realism]]. A [[critic]] writes notes in front of a big painting of Kyiv. The [[curator]] explains the strong [[contrast]] of dark and light colors.

c106.title: Street Art in Kyiv
c106.story: Max shows Anna an old district of Kyiv. Every wall near the station has [[graffiti]] on it. On one house, there is a huge [[mural]] of a big bird. "The city pays for this [[public art]]," Max says. The bird covers the whole [[exterior]] in [[indigo]] and white. Next, they go into an [[art space]] in an old factory. It shows [[contemporary art]] by young artists. One room is full of [[avant-garde]] pictures. Anna buys a [[poster]] by a local [[illustrator]]. An [[art critic]] talks about [[design]] with a young [[designer]]. She shows him a bright [[visual]] for a concert. At home, Anna puts her new picture on the wall.

c107.title: What Shall We Watch?
c107.story: On Friday evening, Anna and Max want to watch a [[film]]. They open their [[streaming service]], but they cannot choose. First, they watch three [[trailers|trailer]]. Anna checks the [[rating]] of each movie. They argue about the [[genre]]. Anna wants a [[thriller]], but Max wants [[sci-fi]]. His movie is about a [[cyborg]] who saves a city. "What about [[fantasy]]?" Anna asks. Then Max gives a [[spoiler]] about the [[sequel]] of a summer [[blockbuster]]. Anna throws a pillow at him, and they watch a comedy.

c108.title: Thursday Night TV
c108.story: On Thursdays at [[prime time]], the family watches TV together. But everyone wants a different [[show]]. Max wants a new [[episode]] of his favorite [[sitcom]]. Grandma prefers a [[game show]] with big prizes. Taras loves a [[reality show]] about young cooks. Mom wants a [[talk show]] with a funny [[gag]] about a cat. Its next [[segment]] is about healthy food. Max sighs and says, "[[Streaming|streaming]] is better [[entertainment]]!" He goes to his room with his laptop. He sends Anna a [[promo]] for a new [[spin-off]]. Then he sends her a short [[clip]], and she laughs.
